p0_failure_class_verification.original_issue: Summary Assist rendered 'Summary assist unavailable' plus '[object Object]' while also showing a visible generated summary and an Accept button, yet still blocking submit

fix_applied.operatorError.js: Normalizes error messages to never show raw objects/JSON/stack traces
fix_applied.DailySummaryAssist.jsx: Shows calm notice (showInlineSummaryNotice) instead of blocking error (showSummaryError) when error occurs but visible summary exists

context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 Summary Assist error handling fix verified. The fix ensures: (1) [object Object] never appears in UI, (2) valid summaries remain visible during provider failures, (3) Accept button works to approve visible summary, (4) no contradictory 'unavailable' state while summary is usable. Jest tests provide regression coverage for 7 error shape classes. Live UI verification confirmed acceptance-to-submit-readiness transition works correctly.

error_shape_coverage.note: The following error shapes are covered by Jest tests in DailySummaryAssist.errorStates.test.jsx

shapes_tested.name: detail object
shapes_tested.example: { response: { status: 503, data: { detail: { error: 'provider_unavailable', debug: { raw: true } } } } }

shapes_tested.name: validation array
shapes_tested.example: { response: { status: 422, data: { detail: [{ loc: ['body', 'summary'], msg: 'field required', type: 'missing' }] } } }

shapes_tested.name: provider 429
shapes_tested.example: { response: { status: 429, data: { detail: 'Rate limit exceeded' } } }

error_shape_coverage.browser_injection_note: These error shapes cannot be directly injected through browser-only actions without modifying code. The Jest tests provide comprehensive regression coverage. Live browser testing verified the normal flow works correctly.
